data.hypothesis: Replacing the 2,016 serial backward updates per input element with 64 binomial-weighted terminal contributions should reduce work while preserving the 63-step discounting and the specified 64 terminal exponents. Double-precision weight construction and accumulation may affect rounding, so correctness remains to be checked by the controller.
data.notes: The supplied baseline passed all 8 correctness cases with max_abs_error 0. Its measured mean latency was 0.39007941525227696 seconds (three samples). No candidate build, correctness validation, or candidate latency measurement is available in this action; numerical edge cases and latency remain for controller evaluation.
transformations: Preserved terminal indices j=0..63 and payoff exponents 2*j-64; no j=64 payoff is introduced.
Replaced the triangular backward updates with the 63-trial binomial-weighted sum using coefficients C(63,j), Pu^j, and (1-Pu)^(63-j).
Applied exactly 63 discount factors and accumulated weighted payoffs in double precision.
